about: Oracles of the mixer and routing render tests, recorded from the frozen prototype by scripts/golden/engine_oracles.py

live.name: mute_and_solo_during_playback
live.test: not in the prototype's tests (the mute smoother of graph.py, MUTE_RAMP = 256)

rebuilds.edit: A soloed: B and its post-fader send ramp out
B solo-safe: B ramps back in
A unsoloed and muted: A ramps out, its pre-fader send stops at the block

edits.name: kick_muted
edits.note: the kick is silent and still keys the bass compressor

edits.name: bass_soloed
edits.note: only the bass sounds; the kick still keys it

edits.name: kick_into_bus
edits.note: the kick reaches the master through a bus with an EQ, a fader and a pan

edits.name: bus_soloed
edits.note: soloing the bus keeps its source, the kick, and silences the bass

edits.name: nested_buses
edits.note: kick into an inner bus into an outer bus; the bass into the outer one

edits.name: bus_latency
edits.note: R2: a limiter on a bus that the kick feeds directly and the bass by a send
